long_biography.plain_text:
Arnemar helped create Vikingarna’s commercial breakthrough by combining musicianship with business control. After playing guitar and saxophone through the group’s rise, he left the touring lineup in 1984 and concentrated on management and production. He recruited singer Christer Sjögren, invested his own money, tightened the band’s sound and presentation, and guided a recording catalogue that made Vikingarna a Scandinavian dance-band institution.

The brand remained part of Arnemar’s working life after the original group’s farewell. As owner of the Vikingarna name, he authorised a later revival, while Vikingarna International continued under his chairmanship. A trained pilot, he also served on West Air Sweden’s board and the West Atlantic audit committee and undertook flying work through his own company. Music management, however, remains the clearest thread connecting his creative work, ownership and executive career.
